title: Daung Zen Tsung

page_data.en:
Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE.
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No....................
Date..................        February 18th    1916

Sir,
    It is reported that a code telegram has been received at
the Arsenal saying that agents of the Yunnan rebels in Japan
have bought twenty aeroplanes, which they will probably try to
send to Yunnan via Shanghai. In consequence of this telegram
a special watch is being kept outside Woosung.
    Two more men named Daung Zen Tsung (□ □ □) and Woo
Nyoh Ming (□ □ □) have arrived in the Arsenal from Peking
to assist in the watch for officials who desert their post
and come to Shanghai. It is said that Daung and Woo brought
a dispatch from the Central Government containing instructions
to have Ju Ting Fang and Tang Shao Yi watched, as, according
to information alleged to have been received in Peking, they
are in sympathy with the Yunnan rebels.
    General Lu, Deputy Military Governor, who is stationed
at Woosung, visited the Arsenal yesterday. He had tiffin
with Mr. Li Tsoong Nyoh (□ □ □) Director of the Arsenal Works
and General Yang. All three seemed to be on the best of terms.
    It is reported that Nyeu Thih Sung (□ □ □) who was an
officer in the rebel army during the second revolution,
arrived in Shanghai a few days ago, and is staying in the
western part of Frenchtown.
    The City detective named Tsang Ts Yuin (□ □ □) who was
alleged to have taken bribes from the Hwo Woi (□ □ □) gamblers
has been found guilty by the Arsenal Authorities and sentenced
to 3 years imprisonment to be followed by deportation.

                                Your Obedient Servant,

                                MMMMMMMM tung
                                Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.
page_data.zh:
上海工部局。

（印章：上海工部局警务处）
警务处。
（侦探科）

中央侦探队
情报登记处
编号....................
日期..................        1916年2月18日

先生：
    据报，兵工厂收到一封密电，称云南叛军在日本的代理人已购买二十架飞机，他们可能会试图经由上海将这些飞机运往云南。鉴于此电报，吴淞外围正在实施特别监视。
    另有两名分别名为 Daung Zen Tsung（□ □ □）和 Woo Nyoh Ming（□ □ □）的人员已从北京抵达兵工厂，协助监视那些擅离职守并来到上海的官员。据悉，Daung 和 Woo 带来了一份来自中央政府的公函，其中包含指示要求对朱廷芳（Ju Ting Fang）和唐绍仪（Tang Shao Yi）进行监视，因为据称在北京收到的消息显示，他们同情云南叛军。
    驻防吴淞的副督军卢将军昨日访问了兵工厂。他与兵工厂总监李钟岳先生（Li Tsoong Nyoh，□ □ □）及杨将军共进午餐。三人似乎关系极为融洽。
    据报，Nyeu Thih Sung（□ □ □）在二次革命期间曾是叛军军官，于数日前抵达上海，现居住在法租界西部。
    一名名为 Tsang Ts Yuin（□ □ □）的市区侦探，被指控收受 Hwo Woi（□ □ □）赌徒的贿赂，已被兵工厂当局裁定罪名成立，判处三年监禁，随后驱逐出境。

                                您顺从的仆人，

                                MMMMMMMM tung
                                总探长。

警察总监
